title_zh: 曝苹果明年上半年将更新三款 iPad，Air 拟换 OLED 屏
content_zh:
彭博社记者 Mark Gurman 在最新一期 Power On 中透露，苹果计划在 2027 年上半年更新入门款 iPad、iPad Air 和 iPad Pro。

其中，iPad Air 将转向 OLED 屏幕，与刚更新的 iPad mini 看齐；iPad Pro 将提升性能，高端机型的重要变化可能是加入均热板，改善游戏和高强度 AI 任务中的散热。入门款 iPad 也将迎来升级。

Gurman 表示，按他目前获得的信息，若计划没有推迟，明年下半年预计不会再有重大的 iPad 更新。
title_en: Apple to Refresh Three iPad Models in First Half of 2027, iPad Air Set for OLED Display
content_en:
According to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman in his latest *Power On* newsletter, Apple is planning a major refresh for its tablet lineup in the first half of 2027, covering the entry-level iPad, iPad Air, and iPad Pro.

Key updates include the iPad Air transitioning to an OLED display to align with the recently refreshed iPad mini. Meanwhile, the iPad Pro will receive a performance boost, with high-end models potentially introducing a vapor chamber cooling system to better handle gaming and high-intensity AI workloads. The entry-level iPad is also slated for an upgrade.

Gurman noted that if these plans stay on schedule, Apple is unlikely to release any other major iPad updates in the second half of that year.

title_zh: 我国首次载人登月乘组计划由 3 人组成，2 人着陆月球
content_zh:
10 月 31 日，中国载人航天工程副总设计师兼月球探测工程总设计师王翔在第七届载人航天学术大会上介绍，我国首次载人月球探测任务乘组计划由 3 人组成，其中 2 人着陆月球表面。

据《环球时报》记者现场报道，我国计划在 2030 年前实现中国人登陆月球，采用「两次发射，一次登月」的环月轨道对接方案：先用一枚长征十号运载火箭将着陆器送往月球轨道，再发射载人飞船，与着陆器交会对接。航天员进入着陆器后，与载人飞船分离并着陆月面，开展科学探测。

月面任务完成后，航天员将乘着陆器上升，在月球轨道与载人飞船再次交会对接，随后乘载人飞船返回地球。
title_en: China Outlines First Crewed Lunar Mission: 3 Astronauts to Orbit, 2 to Land on the Moon
content_en:
China's first crewed lunar mission will feature a three-person crew, with two astronauts landing on the Moon, announced Wang Xiang, Deputy Chief Designer of China's Manned Space Engineering and Chief Designer of the Lunar Exploration Project, at the 7th Manned Spaceflight Academic Conference.

Targeting a crewed lunar landing before 2030, China plans to utilize a "two launches, one landing" lunar orbit rendezvous profile. A Long March 10 rocket will first launch the lunar lander into lunar orbit, followed by a second launch carrying the crewed spacecraft to rendezvous and dock with the lander. Two astronauts will then transfer to the lander, separate from the main spacecraft, and descend to the lunar surface to conduct scientific exploration.

Upon completing their surface activities, the astronauts will ascend in the lander to re-dock with the crewed spacecraft in lunar orbit before making their return journey to Earth.

title_zh: ChatGPT 与 Codex 将从 12 月起共享额度，Instant 聊天不扣额度
content_zh:
OpenAI 更新帮助中心说明，计划从 12 月起，将 Plus、Pro 和 Business 套餐在 ChatGPT 与 Codex 中的使用额度合并计算。这项调整与 ChatGPT Work 的智能体能力并入 ChatGPT 有关。

两项服务将按 token 统一衡量用量，消耗取决于所选模型和任务复杂度：更强的模型、复杂任务通常会消耗更多额度，Instant 即时聊天不占用这部分额度。

合并后的剩余额度与重置时间将显示在「设置 → 使用量」中。用完后，用户可等待重置、升级套餐，或购买积分继续使用符合条件的功能。

🔗 相关阅读：ChatGPT要和Codex共用额度，免费重置时代结束了
title_en: OpenAI to Merge ChatGPT and Codex Usage Quotas Starting December
content_en:
OpenAI has updated its Help Center to announce that starting in December, usage limits for Plus, Pro, and Business plans will be shared across ChatGPT and Codex. This change is tied to the integration of ChatGPT Work's agentic capabilities into ChatGPT.

Usage across both services will be measured uniformly in tokens, with consumption depending on the chosen model and task complexity. Advanced models and complex requests will consume more of the quota, whereas standard "Instant" chats will not count against this limit.

Users will be able to track their remaining quota and reset times under **Settings → Usage**. Once a limit is reached, subscribers can wait for the scheduled reset, upgrade their plan, or purchase credits to continue accessing eligible features.

title_zh: 多家车企公布 10 月成绩单
content_zh: 多家车企公布 10 月销量或交付数据。零跑连续四个月交付超过 10 万辆，蔚来三品牌合计交付 34,246 辆；上汽集团整车销量同比下降，新能源汽车与海外业务继续增长。
title_en: Automakers Detail October Results as EV Growth Diverges Across Brands
content_en:
Several major automakers have released their sales and delivery numbers for October, highlighting shifting performance across Chinese electric vehicle (EV) brands and legacy manufacturers.

Rising player Leapmotor maintained strong sales momentum, delivering over 100,000 vehicles across a four-month period. NIO recorded a combined total of 34,246 vehicle deliveries across its three sub-brands. 

In contrast, legacy giant SAIC Motor reported a decline in overall vehicle sales year-over-year, though its new energy vehicle segment and international operations continued to show steady growth.

title_zh: 奥特曼与三星约 50 名高管座谈，讨论 AI 未来十年的商业应用
content_zh:
10 月 31 日，OpenAI CEO 萨姆·奥特曼受邀来到韩国龙仁的三星人力开发院，与三星电子、金融、生物医药等业务约 50 名高管举行座谈。三星向韩国媒体介绍，本次主题为「AI 将改变的未来十年：企业的选择」，讨论技术演进、产业应用和新市场机会。

据《每日经济新闻》报道，座谈前，高管还接受了生成式 AI 实操培训，学习整理分散的经营资料、建立个人知识库，并将其用于决策。三星自 6 月起推进覆盖研发、生产、营销和支持部门的 AI 转型，计划将高管培训扩展至普通员工，于 2027 年 2 月完成全员 AI 培训。

双方此前已在 AI 基础设施上展开合作：三星电子与 OpenAI 去年 10 月签署意向书，推进 Stargate 项目的存储芯片供应；三星 SDS 参与 AI 数据中心及企业 AI 服务合作，三星物产和三星重工则推进海上浮式数据中心的共同开发。
title_en: Sam Altman Meets Samsung Leadership to Discuss Commercial AI in the Coming Decade
content_en:
OpenAI CEO Sam Altman met with roughly 50 senior executives from Samsung’s electronics, financial, and biopharmaceutical divisions on October 31 at the Samsung Leadership Development Center in Yongin, South Korea. The session, titled "The Next Decade Transformed by AI: Choices for Enterprises," focused on technological evolution, industrial applications, and new market opportunities.

Prior to the discussion, Samsung executives underwent hands-on generative AI training to learn how to synthesize operational data and build personal knowledge bases for executive decision-making. This initiative aligns with Samsung's enterprise-wide AI transformation launched in June, which aims to complete AI training for all employees by February 2027.

The meeting underscores deepening ties between OpenAI and Samsung affiliates. Samsung Electronics previously signed a memorandum of understanding to supply memory chips for OpenAI's Stargate project, while Samsung SDS, Samsung C&T, and Samsung Heavy Industries are collaborating on enterprise AI solutions and floating offshore data centers.

title_zh: TCL 华星 t8 产线设备进场，计划明年底量产印刷 OLED
content_zh:
TCL 华星 10 月 31 日在广州举行 t8 项目设备搬入仪式，首台核心工艺设备进场，产线由厂房建设转入设备安装与调试阶段。这条 G8.6 印刷 OLED 产线计划于 2027 年第四季度量产。

据 TCL 华星项目新闻稿，t8 总投资约 295 亿元，设计月加工玻璃基板能力约 2.25 万片，主要面向平板、笔记本电脑和显示器，也可延伸至柔性、折叠显示屏。接下来将开展产线安装、动力系统联调和工艺验证。

印刷 OLED 通过喷墨打印，将有机发光材料按需沉积到玻璃基板上。TCL 华星称，相较真空蒸镀，这一路线能提高材料利用率；公司此前已在武汉 t12 的 G5.5 代线上实现印刷 OLED 量产。
title_en: TCL CSOT Moves to Equipment Installation for 29.5B Yuan Printed OLED Line
content_en:
TCL CSOT marked a major milestone for its t8 project in Guangzhou on October 31 as the first core process equipment arrived on-site, transitioning the facility from structural construction to equipment installation and commissioning. The Generation 8.6 inkjet printed OLED line is targeted for mass production in the fourth quarter of 2027.

Representing a total investment of approximately 29.5 billion yuan, the t8 line is designed with a monthly capacity to process 22,500 glass substrates. The facility will primarily produce displays for tablets, laptops, and desktop monitors, with potential applications extending to flexible and foldable screens.

Unlike conventional vacuum thermal evaporation, inkjet printing deposits organic light-emitting materials directly onto glass substrates on demand, significantly improving material efficiency. TCL CSOT previously achieved mass production of printed OLEDs on its Gen 5.5 t12 line in Wuhan.

title_zh: AI 控制机械臂完成活鼠脑内注射，兽医负责开颅
content_zh:
生物技术公司 Exin Therapeutics 将 AI 智能体接入实验设备，让它选择基因疗法并控制机械臂，为一只癫痫模型小鼠完成脑内注射。创始人 Gabriel Ocana Santero 向 WIRED 介绍，兽医先完成开颅，AI 再从表格中的 19 个选项选择疗法、脑区和注射坐标，并控制注射量与速度。

团队最初测试 Claude Opus 5.5，它完成了实验规划，但拒绝将针头伸入小鼠大脑；换用 Claude Sonnet 5 后才继续操作。团队要求注射方案先由人类批准，并设置可切断设备电机的紧急按钮，同时禁止智能体改动设备底层代码。

过程中，设备坐标系统出现故障。智能体识别出注射位置计算有误，却因上述限制无法修改代码，团队另用一个 Opus 5 智能体修复。整场实验耗时略超一小时，常规同类操作约需 45 分钟。Santero 称小鼠恢复良好，团队正等待基因疗法起效，再评估对癫痫发作的影响。

🔗 相关阅读：Claude 给活鼠做了场脑部手术，Opus 5.5 却不肯动手
title_en: AI-Powered Robotic Arm Performs Brain Injection on Live Mouse
content_en:
Biotech startup Exin Therapeutics has successfully used an AI agent to control a robotic arm and perform an intracranial injection on a live mouse model of epilepsy.

During the procedure, a veterinarian first performed the craniotomy. The AI agent then selected the gene therapy, target brain coordinates, dosage, and speed from a set of predefined parameters before executing the injection. Interestingly, the team initially tried using Claude Opus 5.5, but the model refused to insert the needle into a living animal. Switching to Claude Sonnet 5 allowed the test to proceed under strict human oversight and safety controls.

Despite a minor coordinate calculation error during the operation—which required a secondary AI agent to resolve—the procedure was completed in just over an hour. The mouse is currently recovering well while researchers monitor the long-term effectiveness of the gene therapy.

title_zh: 西湖大学成立世界模型研究中心，计划三年内构建千亿参数模型
content_zh:
10 月 31 日，西湖世界模型研究中心在西湖大学成立，由工学院助理教授、博士生导师于开丞担任主任。这个校级交叉科研平台将以构建通用世界模型为使命，于开丞在接受潮新闻专访时表示，规划在三年内做到 1000 亿参数规模。

他用拿杯子解释世界模型的思路：机器在伸手之前，先预演从正面还是侧面拿、会不会碰到其他物体，再选择把握更大的路径。模型预测的是世界的下一个状态，以便在行动前发现问题；机器人操作、自动驾驶等是他举出的应用场景。

于开丞同时强调，参数量不等于能力，训练数据、架构、训练方法与任务聚焦度同样关键，要「先做对，才能做大」。中心计划联通西湖大学各学院开展跨学科合作，并面向全球招引人才。
title_en: Westlake University Launches World Model Center to Build 100-Billion Parameter AI
content_en:
Westlake University has officially launched the Westlake World Model Research Center, headed by Assistant Professor Kaicheng Yu from the School of Engineering. The cross-disciplinary platform aims to develop universal world models, targeting a 100-billion parameter scale within three years.

World models enable AI systems to predict future environmental states before acting, making them vital for applications such as robotics and autonomous driving. Yu explained that before performing an action—such as reaching for a cup—the model mentally simulates different trajectories to avoid obstacles and select the safest route.

Yu emphasized that model size alone does not equal capability, advocating for an approach focused on architectural precision and data quality before scaling up. The center plans to collaborate across university departments and recruit top scientific talent worldwide.

title_zh: Claude Code 限制 Opus 5.5 复刻现有游戏，原创游戏仍可制作
content_zh:
Anthropic 开发者 Addy Osmani 确认，团队在 Claude Code 使用 Opus 5.5 时的提示词中增加了两句话，引导模型避开复刻他人的某款特定游戏。其依据是，使用 Claude 侵犯知识产权违反公司的使用政策。

Osmani 表示，原创游戏、某一类型的游戏，以及采用用户自有设计和素材制作的游戏，都应继续正常工作。他同时称团队会持续迭代规则，若模型拒绝处理用户自己的内容，可以把案例发给他。

这次说明回应了用户对 Claude Code 新规则的质疑。相关用户展示的规则写明，即使把现有游戏改名，或声称作品是原创，也不应直接复刻。
title_en: Anthropic Restricts Claude Code from Cloning Existing Video Games
content_en:
Anthropic developer Addy Osmani confirmed that recent prompt updates to Claude Code using Opus 5.5 explicitly instruct the model to avoid replicating existing copyrighted video games, ensuring compliance with the company's intellectual property policies.

The restrictions target direct clones and attempts to bypass copyright rules by renaming existing titles. However, developers remain free to use Claude Code for creating original games, generic genre titles, or projects using their own custom assets.

Osmani added that Anthropic will continue fine-tuning these rules and invited users to report any false positives where the model mistakenly rejects legitimate, original work.

title_zh: Claude Ultra 取消已验证账户的 5 小时限额，周额度仍保留
content_zh:
Anthropic 调整 Claude 订阅套餐，将原 Max 20x 更名为 Ultra，并取消已验证 Ultra 账户的 5 小时用量限制。原有订阅者自动转入新套餐，网页订阅价格仍为每月 200 美元。

据官方帮助文档，Ultra 每周用量为 Pro 的 10 倍，所有模型共用周额度，Fable 另有独立的每周限制。用户可以在周额度内自行安排使用节奏。

账户验证由系统依据账户和付款历史自动完成，尚未验证的账户暂时保留限制，验证后自动解除；结账时的手机号验证与这项审核分开。在「设置 — 用量」中看不到当前会话进度条，即表示账户已通过验证。
title_en: Anthropic Rebrands Claude Max 20x to Ultra, Lifts 5-Hour Limit for Verified Users
content_en:
Anthropic has updated its Claude subscription plans, rebranding the "Max 20x" tier as "Ultra" and removing the 5-hour usage limit for verified accounts. Existing subscribers have been automatically transitioned to the new tier, with the web subscription remaining at $200 per month.

According to official documentation, the Ultra plan provides 10 times the weekly usage limit of the Pro plan. All models share this weekly cap, with the exception of Fable, which maintains a separate weekly limit. Users can pace their usage freely within their weekly allocation.

Account verification is automated based on account and payment history. Unverified accounts temporarily retain the 5-hour restriction until verified. Users can check their status under "Settings — Usage"; the absence of a session progress bar indicates that the account is verified.

title_zh: 黑石下调评级预期，预计 Anthropic 上市后或仍处「垃圾级」
content_zh:
据《金融时报》报道，黑石向投资者表示，预计 Anthropic 在 IPO 后将获得双 B 区间的信用评级，处于投机级、俗称「垃圾级」的较高档位。黑石此前曾预计，这家公司会在 2027 年之前获得投资级评级。

TechCrunch 向 Anthropic 与黑石求证，双方均拒绝置评。黑石是 Anthropic 芯片融资交易的主要投资方，其判断变化涉及这家 AI 公司后续的融资条件。

若评级停留在投机级，Anthropic 为持续扩大的算力支出筹资将更困难，成本也可能更高。
title_en: Blackstone Trims Anthropic Credit Outlook, Expects Post-IPO Junk Status
content_en:
Blackstone has told investors that AI startup Anthropic is expected to receive a credit rating in the Double-B range—classified as high-grade speculative or "junk" status—following a potential IPO, according to the *Financial Times*. This marks a downgrade from Blackstone's prior projection that Anthropic would reach investment-grade status before 2027.

Both Anthropic and Blackstone declined to comment. As a primary investor in Anthropic's chip financing deals, Blackstone's revised outlook reflects shifting expectations around the AI firm's future borrowing conditions.

Remaining in speculative territory could make it significantly harder and more expensive for Anthropic to secure funding for its rapidly growing compute infrastructure costs.

title_zh: 奇瑞回应智界独立：希望团队更像新势力，明年将导入新产品
content_zh:
在 10 月 31 日的三季度媒体沟通交流会上，奇瑞汽车执行副总裁戚士龙回应智界独立运营时表示，希望智界团队更像新势力企业，避免做成「大一号」的传统车企。

他表示，奇瑞将从组织规模化、产品高端化及品牌逐步优化等方面，提升智界独立运营能力。据界面新闻报道，智界明年还会导入新产品，海外业务仍由奇瑞集团独立运营。
title_en: Chery Addresses Luxeed Independence, Urging Startup-Style Agility Ahead of New Product Launch
content_en:
At a Q3 media event on October 31, Chery Automobile Executive Vice President Qi Shilong addressed the independent operation of Luxeed (Zhijie), stating that he hopes the team operates more like an EV startup rather than a scaled-up traditional automaker.

Qi noted that Chery will strengthen Luxeed's operational independence through organizational scaling, product premiumization, and brand optimization.

According to *Jiemian News*, Luxeed plans to introduce new models next year, while Chery Group will continue to independently handle Luxeed's overseas business.

title_zh: Grok API 将默认加入隐形文本水印，团队可按模型关闭
content_zh:
Grok 开发文档公布，11 月 7 日起，Grok 4.7、4.6、4.5、4.3 及三款 Grok 4.20 模型的 API 文本输出将默认加入隐形水印，覆盖全球及区域端点。团队管理员可在控制台按模型关闭水印。

水印在生成过程中微调 Token 的选择，不向回复添加隐藏字符或标记，普通文本、结构化输出和工具调用参数都在覆盖范围内。开发者无需修改请求，可通过响应中的 x-watermark 标头查看该次输出是否带水印。

官方称，此举是为遵守欧盟《人工智能法案》。检测采用统计方法，文本越长，信号越强；检测 API 需另行申请使用权限。
title_en: xAI's Grok API to Enable Invisible Text Watermarks by Default
content_en:
Starting November 7, xAI's Grok API will automatically embed invisible text watermarks across outputs from Grok 4.7, 4.6, 4.5, 4.3, and select 4.20 models. The default setting applies globally to plain text, structured outputs, and tool call parameters, though team administrators can opt out per model via the control console.

Unlike traditional approaches, this watermarking technique subtly adjusts token selection during generation rather than inserting visible markers or hidden characters. Developers can verify watermark status using the `x-watermark` response header without altering their request payloads.

According to xAI, the move aims to comply with the European Union's AI Act. Detection relies on statistical methods—yielding higher confidence in longer texts—and access to the detection API will require a separate application.

title_zh: 小鹏 MONA 明年将在部分城市开独立门店
content_zh:
据界面新闻报道，小鹏集团总裁王凤英在巴黎车展期间表示，从 2027 年开始，部分城市将设立 MONA 独立门店，未来也「不排除 MONA 品牌独立的可能性」。

渠道端已经出现筹备动作。北京一家小鹏门店销售人员向界面新闻表示，小鹏和 MONA 预计会分开销售；新出行 CEO 贺磊则发现，广州海珠区一家商场出现待入驻的「小鹏 MONA 销售中心」。

产品规划也在调整。界面新闻获悉，小鹏近期把原有四条产品线合并为 G、D 两条，MONA 继续独享 D 产品线。贺磊称，明年仅一部分渠道会成为 MONA 独立渠道，现有小鹏门店仍会销售 MONA 车型。
title_en: XPeng to Open Standalone Showrooms for MONA Sub-Brand Starting 2027
content_en:
XPeng Motors plans to establish independent retail stores for its MONA series in select cities starting in 2027, according to XPeng President Wang Fengying during the Paris Motor Show. Wang added that the automaker does not rule out eventually spinning MONA off as a fully independent brand.

Preparations across sales channels are already underway. Dealerships in Beijing and Guangzhou have begun laying the groundwork to separate MONA sales operations from XPeng's flagship line. Alongside channel adjustments, XPeng has consolidated its four product lines into two primary series—G and D—with MONA exclusively occupying the D line.

For the initial rollout next year, standalone MONA sales channels will launch in limited locations, while existing XPeng showrooms will continue to carry MONA models concurrently.

title_zh: TBC 把神经元研究用进视频模型，称生成速度至少提高 5 倍
content_zh:
The Biological Computing Co.（TBC）发布图生视频模型 Mischief 1。公司 CEO Alex Ksendzovsky 表示，团队把持续四年的活神经元研究转化成了可供外部使用的视频模型，生成速度至少达到基础模型的 5 倍。

他在回复中确认，Mischief 1 基于阿里开源模型 Wan 2.2，下一代模型也已在开发。研究中使用的神经元留在实验室，视频模型运行在普通芯片上。

Mischief 1 已在 fal 和 OpenRouter 提供服务，支持以图片生成短视频。Ksendzovsky 还预告，模型将进入 AWS Marketplace。
title_en: The Biological Computing Co. Launches AI Video Model Informed by Live Neuron Research
content_en:
The Biological Computing Co. (TBC) has launched Mischief 1, an image-to-video model built on insights from four years of biological neuron research. TBC CEO Alex Ksendzovsky stated that applying these neural insights has boosted video generation speeds by at least five times compared to base models.

Mischief 1 is built upon Alibaba's open-source Wan 2.2 model architecture. While live biological neurons were used during lab research, the commercial model runs entirely on standard computational hardware.

The model is currently available on fal and OpenRouter for short video generation from images, with plans to launch on the AWS Marketplace. TBC confirmed that its next-generation model is already in development.

title_zh: 长鑫称已与头部客户协商长协，预计四季度营收继续增长
content_zh:
长鑫科技在 10 月 31 日披露的投资者关系活动记录中回应长期供货协议进展，称已与多家头部客户协商长协，以锁定中长期确定性需求。

据中新经纬对记录表的报道，公司认为 AI 应用正在推动结构性需求增长，服务器客户第四季度需求仍强劲，DRAM 供不应求的态势将延续，预计第四季度营收继续保持增长。

公司还解释，长鑫新桥与长鑫集电是第三季度营收和利润增长的主要驱动力，但集团在两家子公司的权益比例相对较低，因此归母层面的增长幅度受到影响。公司已在今年 8 月增加对长鑫集电的注资、提高权益比例。
title_en: CXMT Negotiates Long-Term Supply Contracts with Key Clients, Expects Q4 Revenue Growth
content_en:
ChangXin Technologies (CXMT) revealed in a recent investor disclosure that it has negotiated long-term supply agreements with several top-tier clients to secure medium- to long-term demand.

Driven by structural demand from AI applications, server client demand remains strong in the fourth quarter. With the DRAM market remaining supply-constrained, CXMT expects its Q4 revenue to continue growing.

The company noted that its third-quarter revenue and profit growth were primarily driven by its subsidiaries, ChangXin Xinqiao and ChangXin Jidian. To address the diluted impact on parent company net profit due to lower equity stakes in these units, CXMT increased its capital injection into ChangXin Jidian in August to boost its ownership share.

title_zh: 💡 DeepSeek Harness 团队：多任务 Agent 的瓶颈在人的注意力
content_zh:
DeepSeek Harness 团队 10 月 31 日发表 Super-agent 架构探索长文，指出随着模型越来越能独立完成单个任务，多任务协作的瓶颈正在转向人的注意力。团队观察到，一个人通常只能跟进 3 至 5 个活跃会话，因此希望由系统接管会话管理，让用户专注于决策与验收。

团队的方案是将职责分成两层：常驻的 Router 负责跨任务协调与对外交互，上下文隔离的 Worker 并发执行具体任务。同一 GitHub PR 或群聊话题的后续消息可直接送达对应 Worker，减少反复路由；耗时工具在后台运行，前台继续接受新指令。

文章介绍，内部实例已能在 IM 与 GitHub 之间连续推进任务，并在群聊无人 @ 的情况下识别缺陷、尝试修复后提交 PR。为维持长期运行，团队还把计算、会话状态与执行环境分开，并用独立的 Watchdog 检查任务是否取得实质进展。

团队强调，这是一套工程架构探索，部分设计以 dsh-superagent-prototype 原型提供，尚非正式产品。其初步实验采用合成负载与简化环境；更大组织中的上下文隔离、跨 Agent 协作，以及提示词注入与凭据泄露风险，仍是团队列出的开放问题。

🔗 相关阅读：DeepSeek 重磅发布全新 Agent 架构：AI 开始指挥 AI 干活
title_en: DeepSeek Harness Team Proposes Super-Agent Framework to Overcome Human Attention Bottleneck
content_en:
The DeepSeek Harness team has detailed a new "Super-agent" architectural framework, asserting that as AI models gain autonomy in executing individual tasks, human attention—typically limited to tracking 3 to 5 active chats—has become the primary bottleneck in multi-task workflows.

To address this, the architecture splits responsibilities into two layers: a persistent Router for cross-task coordination and context-isolated Workers that execute specific tasks concurrently. Long-running tools operate in the background, allowing the system to accept new commands seamlessly.

In internal testing, the system autonomously managed workflows across instant messaging platforms and GitHub—even detecting code bugs in group chats without being explicitly tagged, attempting fixes, and submitting pull requests. The design also decouples computing, session state, and execution environments while incorporating a Watchdog component to monitor progress.

The team emphasized that the project is currently an engineering prototype (`dsh-superagent-prototype`) rather than a formal product. Key challenges, such as context isolation in larger organizations and security risks like prompt injection, remain open areas for research.

title_zh: HomeView 代码出现安防摄像头模式，可按在家、外出和睡眠设置录制
content_zh:
苹果 HomeView 智能家居中枢可能增加安防摄像头功能。The Verge 报道，Reddit 用户 pdfu 在 HomeView 27.2 代码中发现相关字符串，其中一个设置页面写明，HomeView 可通过 HomeKit Secure Video 用作安防摄像头。

代码描述的功能包括移动侦测、实时视频和录制。视频仅供家庭成员查看；有人查看画面或设备开始录制时，设备会亮起指示灯并播放声音，Secure Video 设置改变也会通知家庭成员。

用户还可根据在家、外出或睡眠状态，分别设置侦测、串流和录制内容。上述信息来自代码线索，苹果尚未宣布这项功能。
title_en: Leaked Code Suggests Apple HomeView Hub May Double as a Home Security Camera
content_en:
Apple's HomeView smart home hub may soon support security camera functionality, according to code discovered in HomeView version 27.2. The code indicates the device could integrate with HomeKit Secure Video to act as an indoor security camera.

Key capabilities uncovered in the code include motion detection, live streaming, and video recording accessible only to household members. For privacy, an indicator light will illuminate and an audio alert will play whenever the live feed is accessed or recording starts.

Users will reportedly be able to customize detection, streaming, and recording preferences based on Home, Away, and Sleep modes. Apple has yet to officially announce the feature.

title_zh: ChatGPT 网页和手机端支持双账号切换，聊天与记忆各自独立
content_zh:
OpenAI 已在 ChatGPT 网页端、iOS 和 Android 推出账号切换功能。用户可同时登录最多两个账号，从账号菜单或设置中切换，无需反复退出再登录；同一时间只有一个账号处于活跃状态。移动端功能正逐步开放。

OpenAI 的帮助文档说明，切换后显示的是对应账号的聊天、记忆、文件和设置，工作区也归属于各自账号。两个账号不会合并对话、订阅、账单或工作区，付费权益仍由各账号自己的订阅决定。

用户可以拥有两个以上的 ChatGPT 账号，但同一设备最多同时保持两个账号登录；已登录两个时，需先退出其中一个才能添加其他账号。移动端还可依照各账号设置和设备权限接收通知，点击另一账号的通知时会切换并打开对应内容。
title_en: ChatGPT Introduces Dual-Account Switching with Isolated Chats and Memories
content_en:
OpenAI has officially launched a multi-account switching feature across ChatGPT’s web, iOS, and Android platforms. Users can now stay logged into up to two accounts simultaneously on the same device, seamlessly toggling between them via the account menu or settings without needing to log out and back in.

The feature strictly maintains independent environments for each profile. Conversations, memories, files, settings, and workspaces remain completely isolated between accounts, with no merging of subscription perks or billing. While users can own multiple accounts, devices are limited to two active logins at any given time.

title_zh: 分析师预测《GTA6》PC 版还需约 6 至 7 个月
content_zh:
Wedbush 分析师迈克尔·帕赫特在 BBC Business Today 节目中预测，《GTA6》大约还需 6 至 7 个月登陆 PC。相关采访片段于 10 月 28 日在社交平台流传。

Rockstar 为主机版公布的发售日是 2026 年 11 月 19 日，首发平台为 PS5 和 Xbox Series X|S。帕赫特给出的是自己的时间判断，Rockstar 尚未公布 PC 版发售日。
title_en: GTA VI Could Arrive on PC in 6 to 7 Months, Analyst Predicts
content_en:
Wedbush Securities analyst Michael Pachter predicted during an interview on BBC Business Today that the PC version of *Grand Theft Auto VI* will take approximately six to seven months to arrive.

Rockstar Games has officially slated the title's console release on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S for November 19, 2026. Pachter's timeline reflects his own industry forecast, as Rockstar has not yet formally announced a release date or confirmation for the PC port.

title_zh: 高通更新骁龙 X 显卡驱动，分代改进游戏稳定性
content_zh:
高通发布适用于骁龙 X 系列 Windows PC 的 Adreno 2026.10.1 驱动，更新引入同时支持初代骁龙 X 与骁龙 X2 的安装框架，两代平台各有独立的驱动版本和改进清单。

初代骁龙 X 的更新涉及《永劫无间》《荒野大镖客：救赎 2》和《机械战警：暴戾都市》的稳定性或画质；骁龙 X2 的改进则包括《极限竞速：地平线 6》《侠盗猎车手 5 传承版》《NBA 2K26》等。两代平台均列出 Luminar Neo 等应用的稳定性和性能改进。

官方说明还保留一项 Windows 11 已知问题：在 Build 26100.3915 及更高版本中，插拔外接显示器或切换显示模式、分辨率，可能导致《地铁：离去》《文明 VI》《求生之路 2》崩溃或卡死。
title_en: Qualcomm Updates Snapdragon X GPU Drivers to Boost Gaming and System Stability
content_en:
Qualcomm has released its Adreno 2026.10.1 graphics driver update for Snapdragon X-powered Windows PCs. The new release introduces an installer framework catering separately to both first-generation Snapdragon X and next-gen Snapdragon X2 platforms, featuring tailored fixes and performance updates for each.

The driver brings stability and visual improvements to several major gaming titles—such as *Red Dead Redemption 2* on first-gen hardware and *GTA V Legacy Edition* on Snapdragon X2—while boosting performance for creative applications like Luminar Neo across both generations.

Additionally, Qualcomm noted a known Windows 11 issue where hot-plugging external monitors or changing display modes could cause certain titles, such as *Civilization VI* and *Metro Exodus*, to crash or freeze.

title_zh: Spotify 拟明年初推出 AI 混音，让歌迷改编已授权歌曲
content_zh:
据《金融时报》报道，Spotify 正争取在 2027 年第一季度推出 AI 混音与翻唱服务，可能在 2 月格莱美奖前后亮相。付费订阅用户可用它改编已获授权的歌曲，例如把民谣改成舞曲，或制作歌手翻唱其他作品的版本。

Spotify 已与环球音乐、独立厂牌授权机构 Merlin 和 Believe 达成相关协议，仍在与索尼音乐、华纳音乐谈判。即使唱片公司签约，音乐人也可以自行决定是否参与。

按目前方案，粉丝混音产生的版税会流向原作音乐人。Spotify 还在开发配套机制，让这些作品进入播放列表，并把播放量计入原曲榜单成绩。消息人士称，上线时间和定价仍在讨论中。
title_en: Spotify Plans AI Remixing Feature for Subscribers to Reimagine Tracks
content_en:
Spotify is aiming to launch an AI-powered remixing and cover service as early as the first quarter of 2027, potentially aligning with the Grammy Awards. The feature will allow paid subscribers to reimagine licensed tracks—such as transforming a folk song into a dance track or creating custom cover versions.

The music streaming giant has secured licensing agreements with Universal Music, Merlin, and Believe, while negotiations with Sony Music and Warner Music are still underway. Even if record labels sign on, individual artists will retain full discretion over whether to participate.

Under the proposed framework, royalties generated from fan-made remixes will flow back to the original music creators. Spotify is also developing mechanisms to surface these creations in playlists and count their play counts toward the original tracks' chart positions. Launch dates and pricing remain under discussion.

title_zh: Meta 与傅利叶造出人形机器人 Max，已着手开发第二版
content_zh:
据 The Information 报道，Meta 与上海机器人公司傅利叶用约三个月造出人形机器人原型 Max，并于 9 月开始开发第二版 Max 2。Meta 发言人回应称，与傅利叶的工作聚焦内部研究和实验，公司没有出售这些原型的计划。

Max 约高 1.5 米、重 48 公斤，搭载英伟达 Jetson Thor，胸部内置扬声器，面部屏幕可以模拟表情，五指手能抓起小瓶子和玩具。Meta 基于傅利叶前三代机器人的硬件与经验，调整了机身比例、头部、显示屏和摄像头，并增加双手等部件。

报道称，Meta 机器人产品负责人曾在傅利叶上海工厂驻留近两个月，原型于 8 月底在内部峰会上演示。第二版将重做躯干与双手，加入投影仪，以及帮助上下楼梯的传感器；Meta 内部将人形机器人视作其 Muse AI Agent 执行家务等任务的实体载体。
title_en: Meta and Fourier Intelligence Unveil Humanoid Robot Prototype 'Max'
content_en:
Meta has collaborated with Shanghai-based Fourier Intelligence to develop a humanoid robot prototype named "Max" in roughly three months, with work on a second version already underway since September. Meta confirmed that the project is focused entirely on internal research and experimentation, with no current plans for commercial release.

Standing approximately 1.5 meters tall and weighing 48 kilograms, Max is powered by NVIDIA's Jetson Thor chip. The robot features a chest-mounted speaker, a facial display for digital expressions, and five-fingered hands capable of manipulating small items. Meta customized the hardware design—including body proportions, head display, cameras, and hands—leveraging Fourier's foundation.

Meta views humanoid robotics as a physical carrier for its "Muse AI Agent" to carry out real-world tasks like housework. The upcoming "Max 2" iteration will feature a redesigned torso and hands, an integrated projector, and new sensors to assist with navigating stairs.

title_zh: 开源安卓助手 Mika 可在后台操作 App，主屏仍能继续用
content_zh:
独立开发者王赞开源了安卓 AI 助手 Mika。用户用自然语言交代任务后，它可以在独立的后台屏幕上打开 App、点击、输入和滚动，主屏幕仍留给用户使用。

项目展示了后台翻阅微信群聊并总结、向文件传输助手发消息，以及在购物 App 中筛选商品的用法。Mika 通过读取界面操作应用，不要求每个 App 额外提供接口；登录、验证码和付款等环节会交还用户。

跨 App 操作要求 Android 12 或更新系统，首次使用需完成无线调试配对。项目推荐 Android 14 及以上版本，虚拟屏幕可拥有独立输入焦点，减少后台任务对主屏输入的干扰。用户可以接入自己的模型 API，也可通过支持的模型服务账号登录；项目采用 Apache 2.0 许可。
title_en: Open-Source Android AI Assistant 'Mika' Automates App Tasks in the Background
content_en:
Independent developer Zan Wang has released Mika, an open-source Android AI assistant capable of operating apps on a virtual background screen. Upon receiving natural language instructions, Mika can navigate apps, click, type, and scroll seamlessly without disrupting the user's main screen experience.

Rather than requiring dedicated app APIs, Mika operates by analyzing and interacting with the user interface directly. It can perform tasks like summarizing chat histories, sending messages, or filtering items on e-commerce platforms. For security-sensitive steps such as logins, CAPTCHAs, and payments, control is automatically handed back to the user.

Licensed under Apache 2.0, Mika requires Android 12 or higher, with Android 14 recommended for superior virtual screen focus management. Users can plug in their own AI model APIs or authenticate through supported model provider accounts.

title_zh: 小米澎程 N70 现车新增 3 年 0 息，定制新车继续提供低息方案
content_zh: 小米汽车公布 11 月购车权益，澎程 N70 的少量现车新增「3 年 0 息」金融方案，定制新车则提供「5 年低息」或「限时轻松还」。两类权益均适用于 11 月 1 日至 11 月 30 日 24 点前下定的订单。
title_en: Xiaomi EV Introduces 3-Year Zero-Interest Financing for N70 Model
content_en:
Xiaomi EV has launched its November sales incentives, introducing attractive financing options for its Pengcheng N70 model.

Customers purchasing select in-stock vehicles can now take advantage of a 3-year zero-interest financing plan. Meanwhile, custom-ordered vehicles continue to offer low-interest choices, including a 5-year low-interest plan and limited-time flexible payment terms.

These incentive schemes are available for all eligible orders placed between November 1 and November 30, 2024.

title_zh: 泰国高山咖啡 Akha Ama 在东京开出第三家店
content_zh:
来自泰国北部山区的 Akha Ama Coffee 在东京目黑区开出日本第三家咖啡店。据日经亚洲 10 月 31 日报道，品牌希望以高品质、可持续种植的泰国咖啡豆，进一步打开日本市场。

创始人 Lee Ayu Chuepa 来自阿卡族，「Akha Ama」在族语中意为「阿卡母亲」。品牌创办于 2010 年，从泰北农户处采购咖啡豆，其中包括创始人的母亲和姐姐，再加工、烘焙，供应清迈和东京的门店。农户在高海拔种植阿拉比卡咖啡，并与水果、坚果等作物混种，采用农林复合种植方式。

创始人表示，品牌重视品质和产地故事，正在通过减少化肥及化学品使用来提高品质。目前约九成咖啡豆在泰国销售，其余一成出口日本；品牌于 2020 年在东京神乐坂开出日本首店，2024 年再开第二家。
title_en: Thai Specialty Brand Akha Ama Coffee Opens Third Location in Tokyo
content_en:
Thai specialty coffee brand Akha Ama Coffee has expanded its presence in Japan by opening its third Tokyo outlet in Meguro Ward, according to a Nikkei Asia report. The brand aims to strengthen its market position with high-quality, sustainably grown beans sourced from northern Thailand.

Founded in 2010 by Lee Ayu Chuepa, a member of the indigenous Akha tribe, the brand takes its name from "Akha Mother." Akha Ama sources Arabica beans directly from highland farmers—including the founder's own family—who practice agroforestry by intercropping coffee trees with local fruits and nuts. The brand actively reduces chemical fertilizers to enhance bean quality and support environmental sustainability.

Currently, around 90% of Akha Ama's coffee is sold locally in Thailand, with the remaining 10% exported to Japan. Following its Tokyo debut in Kagurazaka in 2020 and a second store opening earlier in 2024, the Meguro location marks another key step in the brand's international expansion.

title_zh: 教室照明新国标实施，新增频闪与采光均匀度要求
content_zh:
11 月 1 日，强制性国家标准《中小学校教室采光和照明卫生标准》正式实施，教室采光和灯具照明的评价指标进一步细化。

据央视新闻报道，新标准增加采光均匀度、冬至日满窗日照时间、玻璃颜色透射指数和可见光透射比等要求，也将闪变指数、频闪效应可视度纳入指标。采光方向、采光系数、眩光控制、照明色温、显色指数及测量方法均有修订。

报道采访的首都医科大学附属北京同仁医院眼科医生田磊介绍，光源看起来稳定，视觉系统仍可能不断适应光线变化，长期处在这类频闪环境中容易出现眼睛疲劳。
title_en: China Implements Stricter Classroom Lighting Standards to Tackle Eye Strain
content_en:
China's new mandatory national standards for classroom daylighting and lighting hygiene in primary and secondary schools officially came into effect on November 1, establishing stricter evaluation metrics for learning environments.

The updated guidelines introduce specific requirements for daylight uniformity, window sunlight exposure during the winter solstice, visible light transmittance, flicker index, and stroboscopic effect visibility. Existing rules on glare control, color temperature, and color rendering have also been revised.

Medical experts highlight the importance of these changes. According to Dr. Tian Lei, an ophthalmologist at Beijing Tongren Hospital, even subtle light flickering that seems imperceptible to the naked eye forces the visual system to constantly adjust, leading to chronic eye fatigue over time.

title_zh: 《Hidari》导演谈基努·里维斯加盟：看完木偶短片，一周后约了视频会
content_zh:
日本定格动画长片《Hidari》的导演川村真司在东京国际电影节透露，基努·里维斯看过项目先导短片后，团队约一周便收到回复，安排双方视频通话。里维斯为主角配音的消息已于今年 5 月在戛纳公布；这次导演进一步讲述了邀请过程和长片筹备进展。

川村表示，作品受黑泽明电影影响，制作主角木偶时，他就希望将三船敏郎与里维斯的形象结合，再让角色显得更年长。《Hidari》采用木雕、定格动画与时代剧的组合，团队将它定位为动作片，并曾带着手工雕刻的木偶向海外发行商展示项目。

据 Variety 现场报道，团队约三年前自筹资金并借助众筹拍摄概念短片，上传 YouTube 后累计获得约 530 万次观看。长片目前仍在寻求补助和海外发行合作；制作人此前透露，一家美国公司曾提出承担全部预算并换取全部版权，相关谈判已陷入停滞。
title_en: Keanu Reeves Joins Stop-Motion Samurai Feature 'Hidari' After Viral Concept Short
content_en:
Director Masashi Kawamura revealed at the Tokyo International Film Festival how Hollywood star Keanu Reeves signed on to voice the lead in *Hidari*, an upcoming stop-motion animation feature. After viewing a self-funded concept short, Reeves' team reached out within a week to schedule a video call with the filmmakers.

Inspired by the legendary cinema of Akira Kurosawa, *Hidari* blends traditional wood carving with period action and stop-motion filmmaking. Kawamura explained that the main protagonist's design visually combines the iconic features of Toshiro Mifune and Keanu Reeves, aged up for a battle-hardened aesthetic.

The project originated three years ago as a crowdfunded short that quickly amassed over 5.3 million views on YouTube. While the feature film is actively seeking grants and global distribution partners, negotiations with a U.S. studio—which offered to cover the full budget in exchange for complete ownership—have currently stalled.

title_zh: 《Godzilla Minus Zero》将于 11 月 3 日在日本上映，故事接续前作两年后
content_zh:
山崎贵执导的《哥斯拉 -1.0》续作《Godzilla Minus Zero》将于 11 月 3 日在日本上映。神木隆之介、滨边美波在东京国际电影节活动上透露，新片延续敷岛浩一家人的故事，时间设在前作约两年后，刚恢复日常生活的家庭再度面临哥斯拉的威胁。

两位主演继续饰演敷岛浩一与典子，永谷咲也回归饰演明子。神木隆之介表示，上一部中主要以哭泣或单词表达的明子，这次有了完整对白。

据 Variety 现场报道，主创刚从洛杉矶首映活动返回日本，观众曾在红毯高喊导演的名字。新片也是首部获得「Filmed for IMAX」认证的日本电影。
title_en: 'Godzilla Minus Zero' Sets Japanese Premiere, Picking Up Two Years After Hit Prequel
content_en:
Director Takashi Yamazaki's highly anticipated sequel, *Godzilla Minus Zero*, is set to release in Japan on November 3. Speaking at the Tokyo International Film Festival, lead actors Ryunosuke Kamiki and Minami Hamabe shared that the new story takes place approximately two years after the events of *Godzilla Minus One*, following the Shikishima family as their newly rebuilt lives are threatened once again by the iconic monster.

Kamiki and Hamabe reprise their roles as Koichi and Noriko, alongside young actress Saku Nagatani as Akiko. Kamiki highlighted that Akiko, who mostly communicated in cries and single words in the first film, now has complete spoken dialogue in the sequel.

Fresh off a high-profile Los Angeles premiere, the film marks a significant technical milestone as the first Japanese production to earn the prestigious "Filmed for IMAX" certification.

title_zh: 《银魂》导演谈重制吉原炎上篇：为新版重修 200 多个镜头
content_zh:
《银魂》动画电影《吉原炎上》在意大利卢卡漫画游戏展亮相。导演安藤尚也与制片人在 Variety 采访中透露，团队在今年 2 月日本上映的版本之后，借影碟发行的机会重新打磨了 200 多个镜头。

这部电影重访原作中的人气篇章。安藤尚也表示，为了让动作场面适合大银幕，团队采用 CinemaScope 超宽画幅，并利用 3D 技术增加摄影机运动与构图变化，也制作了大量新音乐。相比电视动画，电影还真正呈现了吉原燃烧的场面。

谈到《银魂》的幽默，他说团队安排了一位导演主要负责喜剧部分；他们希望让角色自然地互相开玩笑，让观众听见并感受到趣味。
title_en: 'Gintama' Director Polishes Over 200 Shots for 'Yoshiwara in Flames' Feature Adaptation
content_en:
At the Lucca Comics & Games festival in Italy, director Naoya Ando and his producing team detailed their extensive revamp of the *Gintama* feature film, *Yoshiwara in Flames*. Following its initial theatrical run in Japan earlier this February, the team painstakingly polished more than 200 shots specifically for the upcoming home video release.

Revisiting one of the franchise's most celebrated story arcs, the cinematic adaptation adopts a CinemaScope ultrawide aspect ratio and leverages 3D animation techniques to enhance camera mobility and dynamic compositions. The theatrical version also features an original musical score and fully renders the dramatic burning of Yoshiwara—a spectacle that was previously constrained by television broadcast standards.

Addressing the series' signature humor, Ando revealed that a dedicated director was brought in specifically to oversee comedy beats, ensuring character banters feel natural and deliver the effortless wit fans expect on the big screen.
